agent_explanation: Controller force is computed as kp * velocity_error without clamping to fmax. In shrunk scenario, body 1 has high speed ~50 m/s away from waypoint, kp=12 gives error force ~579.9 N which exceeds fmax=11.34 N. Checker at step 13 shows force exactly at limit (11.345), but at step 14 it spikes to 579.8 because clamping is missing. Increasing fmax to 200 makes scenario pass, proving cause.
